intro: Add eyes to your GPS data. ITrackZen supports AI dashcams with a road-facing camera and an in-cabin driver camera, so you can see what happened, understand why, and prevent the next incident.

detections.title: Driver distraction
detections.text: Detects when the driver looks away from the road for too long and raises an immediate alert.

detections.title: Drowsiness and fatigue
detections.text: Recognises eye closure and yawning so drivers can be warned before a micro-sleep becomes a crash.

detections.title: Phone usage
detections.text: Identifies handheld phone use while driving and saves the event clip as evidence.

detections.title: Smoking
detections.text: Flags smoking in the cabin to support company policy and protect vehicles and cargo.

detections.title: Forward collision context
detections.text: The road-facing camera records the scene ahead for incident review, claims and coaching.

detections.title: Remote video access
detections.text: Request event footage or live view from the dashboard on supported devices and networks.

how.title: Install the dashcam
how.text: A dual-lens camera is mounted on the windscreen with a clear view of the road and the driver.

how.title: AI analyses in real time
how.text: On-device AI looks for distraction, fatigue, phone use and smoking as the vehicle drives.

how.title: Alert and record
how.text: The driver hears an in-cab warning while a short video clip and GPS data are sent to the platform.

how.title: Review and coach
how.text: Managers review clips beside speed and route data, then coach drivers and resolve disputes.

benefits: Video evidence for accidents, insurance claims and disputes
Real-time driver coaching that reduces risky behaviour
GPS location, speed and sensor data synced with every clip
Works alongside fuel, geofence and ignition alerts
Suitable for trucks, buses, taxis, security and government fleets
privacy_note: Use cameras responsibly. Inform drivers what is recorded and why, follow local privacy and labour laws, and use footage for safety, coaching and evidence.
